overall_goal: Prepare couscous by adding boiling water and letting it absorb

goals.description: Prepare the pot and add the dry couscous
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the couscous, sets up the pot on the stove, and pours the dry couscous into the pot to level it.

goals.description: Measure boiling water, mix it into the couscous, and cover the pot
goals.rationale: The person measures boiling water, pours it over the couscous, stirs the mixture, and covers the pot to let the water absorb.

goals.description: Stir and fluff the rested couscous
goals.rationale: After the couscous has absorbed the water, the person stirs and shakes the pot to fluff the grains.
